description: Returns every fact Little Milwaukee holds about one place by its slug: address, coordinates, hours, phone, website, ownership, family facts, price band, founding year, kind, tags, any disclosure, photos, its sources and when it was last verified, plus the canonical page URL to cite. A deprecated place returns only its name, description, status and URL. An unknown slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

slug.description: Place slug, for example tracks-tavern. search_places and places_near return slugs.

name: get_place
